name: color-picker
title: Color Picker
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Accessible color picker with a saturation and brightness field, hue, alpha, a HEX, RGB or HSL input that validates typing and pasting, copy, saved colors you can reorder without dragging, and an optional popover trigger.

meta.descriptionEs: Selector de color accesible con área de saturación y brillo, tono, alfa, un campo HEX, RGB o HSL que valida lo que escribes o pegas, copia, colores guardados que se reordenan sin arrastrar y un modo popover.

examples.title: Selector de color
examples.description: Selector de color accesible con área de saturación y brillo, tono, alfa, un campo HEX, RGB o HSL que valida lo que escribes o pegas, copia, colores guardados que se reordenan sin arrastrar y un modo popover.

api.name: value
api.description: h in degrees, s and v and a from 0 to 1.

api.name: onValueChange
api.description: Fires on every change, including each pointer move. Unchanged from earlier versions.

api.name: onValueCommit
api.description: Fires once when a drag, a key press, a typed or pasted value, a swatch or the eyedropper settles. Use it for saves and other expensive work.

api.name: format / defaultFormat / onFormatChange
api.description: Format of the text field. Defaults to hex. Typed and pasted text is validated before it is applied, in any of the three formats.

api.name: formats
api.description: Formats offered by the switch. Pass one to hide the switch.

api.name: labels
api.description: English by default. colorPickerLabelsEs is exported. hueLabel, alphaLabel, hexLabel, saturationLabel and eyedropperLabel still win when set.

api.name: swatches / defaultSwatches / onSwatchesChange
api.description: Saved colors. onSwatchesChange or defaultSwatches turns on save, remove and reorder, by buttons, Alt+Arrow and Delete, or drag.

api.name: maxSwatches
api.description: Defaults to 12. At the limit the save button stays visible, aria-disabled, with the reason.

api.name: onCopy
api.description: Fires after the value is copied. The copy is confirmed in a polite live region.

api.name: eyedropper
api.description: auto shows the button and disables it with a reason when the browser has no EyeDropper API. hide-unsupported keeps the earlier behavior.

api.name: ColorPickerPopover
api.description: The same props plus open, onOpenChange and align. The trigger shows the swatch and the value together.

docs: hsvaToCss, hsvaToHex, hexToHsva, parseColor and formatColor are exported. Arrow keys move saturation and brightness. Typed or pasted text is applied only when it parses; otherwise the field keeps it, sets aria-invalid and explains why, and Escape restores the value. Saved colors move with Alt+Arrow and leave with Delete, and the same actions have buttons, so dragging is never the only way (WCAG 2.5.7). When the EyeDropper API is missing the button stays visible with aria-disabled and its reason; eyedropper="hide-unsupported" restores the earlier hiding. The component does not ship a palette. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has (input, label, button, popover). The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors. Adapted behaviors from Arc UI (MIT) are optional and do not change existing props. Format switch, copy, popover mode, the disabled eyedropper and saved-color management are a clean-room build inspired by the shadcn/studio color picker docs (shadcnstudio.com/docs/components/color-picker, free tier under MIT + Commons Clause): idea, layout and interaction only, no code or assets copied.
